name: Star Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a point of cold starlight which pricks through the guard into the chest.

name: Halo Shell
description: Hold a thin ring of starlight about the forearms so a blow slides round it and loses its force.

name: Glint Stride
description: Flick the foot out on a glint of qi and land lightly two paces off the line of attack.

name: Starlight Draw
description: Draw faint starlight in through the crown and settle it in the limbs to steady and strengthen the next blows.

name: Ray Touch
description: Touch the foe's brow with a ray of qi that throws off the eyes and spoils the aim.

name: Spark Turn
description: Turn a thrust aside with a spark of qi struck from the heel of the palm.

name: Pattern Reading
description: Read the foe's stance like a chart of fixed stars and tell where its weight will go next.

name: Revolving Palm
description: Swing the palm round in a short orbit so the blow arrives from the side the foe was not guarding.

name: Revolving Guard
description: Circle both forearms in a steady orbit before the chest so every blow meets a moving wall of qi.

name: Revolving Step
description: Step round the foe on a short curve with the shoulders square and the qi swinging with the stride.

name: Drifting Hold
description: Pull the foe's arm into a slow circle with a drift of qi so the limb cannot strike for a moment.

name: Revolving Turn
description: Wheel the palm over a punch and carry it round in an arc until it spends itself in empty air.

name: Even Course
description: Set the qi turning in a steady course through the limbs so strength stays even through a long exchange.

name: Comet Fist
description: Drive a fist forward on a streak of starlight that lands with a bright burst on the chest.

name: Comet Tail
description: Follow a first blow with a trailing second strike along the same bright line before the foe can recover.

name: Streak Guard
description: Throw a streak of qi across the front of the body that takes the first blow and fades.

name: Comet Step
description: Dart forward in one long bright step that leaves a faint tail of qi where the body stood.

name: Comet Slip
description: Slip along a streak of qi beside a blow and push it past the shoulder with the back of the hand.

name: Tail Veil
description: Leave a faint tail of starlight behind the hand that draws the eye off the real strike.

name: Flare Touch
description: Touch the foe's shoulder and let a flare of qi jar the arm so the next guard comes late.

name: Gleam Mend
description: Lay a hand of soft starlight over a sprain or bruise to ease the pain in yourself or an ally.

name: Polar Fist
description: Plant the lead foot as a fixed point and throw a straight punch that turns the whole body about it.

name: Polar Ward
description: Fix the stance on one steady point and let a blow wheel round the guard without moving it.

name: Polar Step
description: Keep one foot fixed and swing the other through a half circle to change facing in a single beat.

name: Pole Gaze
description: Hold the gaze on one point of the foe while star-qi spreads outward to feel every movement round it.

name: Lodestar Draw
description: Draw the scattered qi in to a single bright point at the core so the limbs answer with more force.

name: Aster Fist
description: Punch with the knuckles spread like points of a star so the blow lands in five small bright places.

name: Aster Ward
description: Raise five points of qi round the body in a star and let a blow break against whichever point it meets.

name: Aster Step
description: Step from point to point of an imagined star on the ground so each stride changes the line.

name: Starpoint
description: Drive two fingers forward with a single point of starlight at the tip that pierces a gap in the guard.

name: Star Tally
description: Count the small points of qi in the field about you and tell how many foes stand near and how strong.

name: Cluster Guard
description: Gather a cluster of qi at the elbow and turn a blow off the arm in a spray of small sparks.

name: Star Mend
description: Rest a point of starlight on a small wound and let it knit the edges in yourself or an ally.

name: Nova Fist
description: Close the fist on gathered starlight and let it burst outward at the instant of contact.

name: Nova Ward
description: Flare a short bright shell of qi round the body at the moment a blow lands and let it soak the force.

name: Nova Step
description: Burst off the back foot on a quick flare of qi and cross the gap before the foe can react.

name: Spark Burst
description: Clap the hands and fling a ring of small sparks outward that stings every foe close about you.

name: Dazzle Hand
description: Open the hand in the foe's face with a sudden burst of light that blinds and throws the aim.

name: Afterglow
description: Hold the last bright burst in the limbs as a steady glow that lends weight to each following blow.
